items.title: 21.10 Samandari dhaarein aur hawa ke naqshe (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ocean currents and wind patterns (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Samandari dhaarein (currents) aur hawa ke naqshe zameen ke mausam ko qaboo karne mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Samandari dhaarein samandar ke pani ki bare paimane ki harkat hain, jo do bare tareeqon se gardish karta hai: satah ke saath aur gehri tahon ke darmiyan. Satah ki dhaarein zyada tar hawa se hain jo samandar ki oopri tah ka pani dhakelti hai. Pani ki amudi gardish, jo darja hararat aur namkeenpan ke farq se chalti hai jo us ki density par asar karte hain, thermohaline circulation kehlati hai (21.13 aur 21.14).

Zameen ka ghoomna bhi samandar ki harkat ki shakal banata hai, aur gyres naam ke bare gol dhaaron ke nizam banata hai. Yeh shimali nisf-kurrah (northern hemisphere) mein clockwise aur junoobi nisf-kurrah mein anticlockwise ghoomte hain. Dhaarein garam pani khat-e-istiwa se qutbon ki taraf le jati aur thanda pani wapas lati hain, jo sayyare ka mausam qaboo karne mein madad deta hai (Fig 21.11).

Hawa ke naqshe zameen ki satah ke na-barabar garam hone se bante hain: garam hawa uthti aur thandi hawa us ki jagah aati hai, jis se trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies jaise hawa ke patte bante hain. Yeh hawayein na sirf satah ka samandari pani chalati balke samandari dhaaron ki simt aur taqat par bhi asar karti hain. Hawa ke naqshe aur samandari dhaarein mil kar sayyare par hararat aur tawanai phailate, aur mausami ilaqon aur mausam par asar karte hain.

blocks.alt: Dashed khat-e-istiwa se bata saada samandari khaaka. Khat-e-istiwa ke oopar North Pacific aur North Atlantic gyres clockwise ghoomte oval; neeche South Pacific, Indian aur South Atlantic gyres anticlockwise. Har oval par qutb ki taraf behne wali taraf narangi (garam dhaara) aur khat-e-istiwa ki taraf behne wali neeli (thandi dhaara).
blocks.caption: Do nisf-kurron mein samandari gyres (Fig 21.11 ke mutabiq asal saada khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hawayein aur zameen ka ghoomna har samandari tas'le (basin) ke satah ke pani ko bare chakkar mein badal dete hain. Har chakkar aik taraf garam pani qutb ki taraf le jata aur doosri taraf thanda pani wapas lata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Qadeem malahon ko safar mein madad dene wali trade winds zameen ke ghoomne aur Sooraj ki hararat se chalti hain. Samandari dhaaron ki tabdeeli duniya ke mausami naqshe badal kar aik ilaqe mein selab aur doosre mein khushk-sali la sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Junoobi nisf-kurrah mein aik toofani nizam clockwise ghoomta dekha gaya. Agar wahi nizam shimali nisf-kurrah mein ho to kis taraf ghoomega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Anticlockwise. Coriolis effect chalti hawa ko junoobi nisf-kurrah mein baen aur shimali mein daen morta hai, is liye kam dabao ke toofan mein ghoom kar aane wali hawa dono nisf-kurron mein ulti simt mein ghoomti hai.

items: Satah ki dhaarein: hawa se; gehri gardish: darja hararat aur namkeenpan (density) se.
Gyres: shimal mein clockwise, junoob mein anticlockwise.
Hawa ke patte: trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies; mil kar hararat phailate.
